name: Mini Utopia Storybook Macaron Candidate B
direction: high-chroma fairy-tale macaron with deeper midtones and stronger value separation
note: Candidate HEX values only. Keep calibration lighting fixed and lock v1.0 only after Godot RAW/LIT review.
review_focus: light colors should remain chromatic under LIT instead of washing to near-white

powder_blue, aqua, lavender and lilac must remain distinct in hue and value

cocoa and deep_ink must anchor structure without looking muddy
glow_gold should feel magical and saturated while remaining an accent
